quests.title: Board Order: Night Lantern Stock
quests.description: Supply 1 Glow Potion so the night watch can keep the reopened greenhouse and footpaths safely lit.

quests.title: Board Order: A Light That Does Not Flicker
quests.description: Leave 1 Excellent-or-better Resonance Draught on the board. The well crew works below the water table and will not go down behind a lamp that gutters.

quests.title: Standing Order: Outer Road Lanterns
quests.description: The watch's monthly draw. Leave 2 Excellent Nightwatch Lanterns on the board and the town pays the contracted rate without anyone having to ask.

quests.title: Standing Order: Infirmary Draw
quests.description: Mira's contracted resupply. Leave 2 Excellent Purified Draughts on the board and the counter stays stocked for a month without her chasing anybody.

quests.title: Road Crews: Coldiron Tincture, Standing Order
quests.description: The crews working the switchback want tincture that keeps in the wet. Brin has written under the notice, in his own hand, that the lichen takes ten years to cover a hand's width and the order does not say how much is enough. Both notes are still up.

quests.title: Infirmary: Steadyhand Tonics, Four Of Them
quests.description: Not a good tonic. Four identical ones. The note is explicit that the infirmary would rather have four bottles it can predict than one it cannot repeat, and that this is not a compliment about anybody's brewing.

quests.title: Infirmary: One Hollowroot Cordial, And It Must Be Perfect
quests.description: A child on the north road who a good cordial will not be enough for. The note names the band and then apologises for naming it. Brin has written underneath that there are nine hollowroot plants in this valley and that he is not objecting, he is only writing it down.

completion_milestones.title: Named The Band
completion_milestones.text: Somebody asked for the best thing this tower can make, in those words, because good would not have been enough. It is the first order in a year that could not have been filled by trying hard. It had to be filled by having got better.

quests.title: Lyra: A Stillkeeper Tonic, The Best You Have Ever Made
quests.description: In her own hand, which she does not usually use on the board. An animal that a Fine tonic will settle and a Masterwork one will save, and she is explicit that she has spent six years arguing this valley out of exactly this kind of request.

quests.title: Switchback Crews: Trailblaze Tonics, Standing
quests.description: The crews cutting the switchback want the hot one. Four of them, and the note says not to substitute the gentle version because somebody already tried that and the crew walked back down at noon.

quests.title: Road Crews: Forgestep, And They Know What It Tastes Like
quests.description: An order for the tonic the crews complain about every single time and order again every single week. Brin has stopped asking them why.

quests.title: Carters: Longstride, For The Far Side
quests.description: The carters have worked out what the salvaged one is for. It is not the tonic you take at the start of a haul. It is the one you take when you are already tired and the far side is still four hours off, and they would like a standing supply.

quests.title: Road Crews: Shiftlong, Three At A Time
quests.description: They have stopped asking for the one that tastes better. Three shiftlong tonics, and the note adds that a crew is three people and one of them going without is worse than all three getting something ordinary.

quests.title: Infirmary: Two On The Shelf, Standing
quests.description: Wren's hand, and unusually long for her. Two standing doses, kept on the shelf rather than carried out, for the nights the second room has somebody in it and she is in the first. She notes that she has spent her whole working life arguing against exceptional medicine and is now ordering a bottle that dispenses itself, and asks you not to make anything of it. It has to be the echoed one; a second bottle beside the bed is not the same thing.

quests.title: Archive: One Table, All Of It At Once
quests.description: Unsigned, but the hand is the archive's and it has stopped pretending otherwise. One tablewide reading, splashed rather than poured — one page at a time is what she has been doing for nine years. The note says the loose sheets have been sorted four times by four different methods and every method agreed, which is the part that has stopped being reassuring.

quests.title: Infirmary: The One You Make Every Week
quests.description: Wren, and she has clearly thought about how to word it. Four healing draughts, and the note says she is not asking for the best one you have ever made -- she is asking for the one you have made so many times that you no longer think about it. She would rather have four identical ordinary bottles than one exceptional one and three guesses.

quests.title: Road Crews: Six Lanterns, All The Same
quests.description: The switchback crews want six lantern draughts and have specified, in a hand that has clearly had this argument before, that they must all burn for the same length of time. A crew that has to guess which of six lamps will go first has six problems. They will pay for the ordinary one, made properly, over anything clever.

quests.title: Archive: Steady Light, Not Bright Light
quests.description: Unsigned again, and by now nobody is pretending. Three glow potions of a consistent burn. The note observes that a reading room lit by a different lamp every evening is a reading room where nobody can tell whether the ink has changed or the light has, and that this has cost the archive more than it would like to put in writing.

quests.title: Board Order: A Light That Flatters Nothing
quests.description: Not on the board where anyone can read it. Two Coldread Solutions, cold and even, and the note says only that she has pages she would rather check than trust. She would not have asked a stranger.

quests.title: Board Order: Something The Shelf Can Hold
quests.description: Two Keptwarm Tonics. The infirmary has been rationing the cold bench for a year and Wren has stopped pretending otherwise in writing, which she would not do for somebody she was still being careful around.

quests.title: Archive: Read The Rank, Not The Book
quests.description: The archive's hand, and it has given up being unsigned. One shelf-wide reading, Excellent. She wants a rank read at a time, working along the wall, before the next damp winter moves the dust and takes the only record of what he was doing at the end.

quests.title: Infirmary: Something That Keeps
quests.description: Wren, briefly. One longheld cordial, Excellent. Her shelf is cold and the cold is a lamp she has to keep lit, and she would like one bottle on it that does not care. She adds that she is aware of what it costs to make and asks anyway.

quests.title: Survey: The Old Logs, Both Ways
quests.description: The survey's first order. One double-read solution, Masterwork, for the well books nobody has checked against the new readings. Lyra's note is that a number written down carefully is not the same as a number taken carefully, and she would rather find that out now than in eleven years.

quests.title: Infirmary: The One That Waits
quests.description: Wren again, shorter. One keptback draught, held rather than spent — she has a patient who will not take anything and will need it in about four hours, and she would rather hand them a bottle now than argue with them then.

quests.title: Survey: A Dose That Does Not Drift
quests.description: Lyra, in the survey's hand rather than her own. Two truemeasure tonics a season, kept sealed, so that what a keeper gives an animal this spring is the same thing she gave one last spring. She notes that the whole point of a standing survey is that nothing in it is allowed to change quietly.

quests.title: Road Crews: The Lamp They Actually Asked For
quests.description: Two banked cinderlights for the switchback crews, standing. They have been sent bright lamps, cheap lamps and lamps with clever shutters, and every time the answer came back the same: it has to still be burning when we come back to it, and it must not go out if we set it down. This is the first light the tower has made that meets the specification as written.

quests.title: Standing Order: The Square, After The Bell
quests.description: One hearthchannel lantern a season for the town hall steps. The hall stays lit long after the working day ends, and the mayor has decided that a light the colour of a forge at the close of a shift says something truer about this valley than the white ward-lamps he was quoted for.

quests.title: Archive: The One She Has Not Labelled
quests.description: One hollowroot reliquary for the archive, and the request carries a condition: it is not to be opened. Ione has one already, on a shelf, unlabelled, which from her is an enormous statement. She would like a second so that the first can stop being the only one.

quests.title: Standing Order: Something That Survives The Cart
quests.description: Two lastthaw cordials a season for the winter runs. Everything else the tower sends over the pass arrives either frozen or turned; this does neither, which the carters regard as the single most useful fact anybody up there has established in twenty years.

quests.title: Infirmary: The One That Keeps Working
quests.description: One longhold cordial for the worst-case shelf. Wren's whole complaint about restoratives is that they buy a good hour and then hand the same problem back; this one works in days rather than hours. She writes that she is not going to pretend the board can pay what it is worth.

quests.title: Road Crews: Three Flares, And They Do Not Care How They Look
quests.description: Three leakfire flares, standing, and the request is unusually blunt about what they are: a glow brew that failed, splashed through a rune, burning fast and ugly. The crews do not want a good lamp for this. They want something cheap enough that setting one off to say 'here, this way' costs nobody anything, and they would rather have three bad ones than one good one.

quests.title: Archive: Read It Twice, Separately
quests.description: Two second readings for the archive. The joke is that they are made out of the failed mixture nobody has a name for, run through an echo rune; the point is that they show the same page twice with a gap in between, and Ione will not accept a reading she has not been able to check against itself. She says a single reading is an opinion.

quests.title: Standing Order: One Night, Unattended
quests.description: One heldstar vigil. It is the deepest thing the tower makes — a lowstar lantern taken to its own limit and then warded — and it does exactly one thing: it burns from dusk to dawn without being tended, trimmed or relit. Elric wants one on the hall steps on the nights the pass is shut, so that anybody coming down late can see there is somebody awake in this valley, which there is not, but the light does not know that.

quests.title: Relief Post: The Four Hours, Kept Warm
quests.description: Two banked-through tonics a season for the post at the head of the switchback. Wren's whole argument for the post was that somebody found at the top of the pass has about four hours in them and most of those hours are spent going cold. A stretcher and a lamp do not fix that. This does, and it does it without anybody having to sit up and tend a fire.

quests.title: Road Crews: One Bottle Instead Of Two
quests.description: Two held-heat lamps for the crews working the lower cut after rain. They have carried a lantern down and stood beside it being cold for as long as there have been crews, because the brazier is the other trip and nobody makes the other trip. Brin notes drily that the tower has had a bench that could do this for twenty years.
